description: Issue a new tenant key and invalidate the current one immediately: every other call using the old key fails as unauthenticated from this point on. Returns the new key exactly once -- use it (as tenant_key or Authorization) for every call after this one.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.key_rotate
